data.name: Fusaylah
data.gender_notes: Fusaylah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic and Arabic culture, Fusaylah refers to a young and energetic horse. This name embodies the spirit of strength, courage, and grace, reflecting the characteristics of the noble animal it is named after. The name Fusaylah carries the meaning “A young horse” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fusaylah usually hope their child will grow to embody a young horse and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the strength and courage of a young believer in Islam.
data.etymology: Fusaylah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A young horse.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fusaylah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fusaylah carries a sense of vigor and mental agility, symbolizing the Arab swift steed, which is admired for its speed, power, and endurance - traits greatly valued in various facets of Islamic life such as warfare, business, or daily life. Moreover, livestock names hold a deep cultural significance in Islamic societies, where they represent an essential part of people's connection to their heritage and pastoral traditions.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Fusaylah can inspire the holder to emulate the valiant spirit of the horse, encouraging them to face challenges with unyielding determination, be responsive to change, and adapt with grace under pressure. This name can also serve as a reminder of the Hadith, in which the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) mentions the virtues of those who compare themselves to their horses, striving to be as faithful, swift, and strong as their mounts.
